"""
Official-style test for Azure B2C client ID in scopes functionality.
This test could be integrated into the main test suite.
"""

import sys
import os
import json
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '.'))

from msal import PublicClientApplication, ConfidentialClientApplication
from tests.http_client import MinimalHttpClient
import unittest


class MockB2CHttpClient(MinimalHttpClient):
    """Mock HTTP client that simulates B2C authority responses."""
    
    def get(self, url, **kwargs):
        # Return mock OpenID configuration for B2C
        if "b2clogin.com" in url and ".well-known/openid-configuration" in url:
            return MockResponse(200, json.dumps({
                "issuer": "https://mytenant.b2clogin.com/mytenant.onmicrosoft.com/v2.0/",
                "authorization_endpoint": "https://mytenant.b2clogin.com/mytenant.onmicrosoft.com/oauth2/v2.0/authorize?p=b2c_1_signupsignin",
                "token_endpoint": "https://mytenant.b2clogin.com/mytenant.onmicrosoft.com/oauth2/v2.0/token?p=b2c_1_signupsignin",
                "end_session_endpoint": "https://mytenant.b2clogin.com/mytenant.onmicrosoft.com/oauth2/v2.0/logout?p=b2c_1_signupsignin"
            }))
        return super().get(url, **kwargs)


class MockResponse:
    """Mock HTTP response."""
    
    def __init__(self, status_code, text):
        self.status_code = status_code
        self.text = text
        self._raw_resp = None
    
    def raise_for_status(self):
        if self.status_code >= 400:
            raise Exception(f"HTTP {self.status_code}")


class TestB2CDecorateScope(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test _decorate_scope behavior for Azure B2C scenarios."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.client_id = "test-client-id-12345"
        self.reserved_scopes = {'openid', 'profile', 'offline_access'}

    def test_regular_authority_client_id_single_scope(self):
        """Test that regular authority still replaces single client ID scope."""
        app = PublicClientApplication(
            client_id=self.client_id,
            authority="https://login.microsoftonline.com/common"
        )
        
        result = app._decorate_scope([self.client_id])
        self.assertEqual(set(result), self.reserved_scopes)

    def test_regular_authority_client_id_mixed_scopes_rejected(self):
        """Test that regular authority still rejects mixed scopes."""
        app = PublicClientApplication(
            client_id=self.client_id,
            authority="https://login.microsoftonline.com/common"
        )
        
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as context:
            app._decorate_scope([self.client_id, 'openid'])
        
        self.assertIn("Client Id can only be provided as a single scope", str(context.exception))

    def test_b2c_authority_client_id_single_scope_preserved(self):
        """Test that B2C authority preserves client ID in single scope."""
        app = PublicClientApplication(
            client_id=self.client_id,
            authority="https://mytenant.b2clogin.com/mytenant.onmicrosoft.com/B2C_1_signupsignin",
            http_client=MockB2CHttpClient()
        )
        
        # Verify B2C is detected
        self.assertTrue(app.authority._is_b2c)
        
        result = app._decorate_scope([self.client_id])
        result_set = set(result)
        
        # Client ID should be preserved along with reserved scopes
        self.assertIn(self.client_id, result_set)
        self.assertTrue(self.reserved_scopes.issubset(result_set))

    def test_b2c_authority_documentation_pattern_works(self):
        """Test the exact pattern mentioned in Azure B2C documentation."""
        app = PublicClientApplication(
            client_id=self.client_id,
            authority="https://mytenant.b2clogin.com/mytenant.onmicrosoft.com/B2C_1_signupsignin",
            http_client=MockB2CHttpClient()
        )
        
        # This is the pattern from the documentation:
        # scopes=['openid', 'offline_access', '<CLIENT_ID>']
        scopes = ['openid', 'offline_access', self.client_id]
        result = app._decorate_scope(scopes)
        result_set = set(result)
        
        # Should contain all specified scopes plus profile (auto-added)
        expected = {'openid', 'offline_access', 'profile', self.client_id}
        self.assertEqual(result_set, expected)

    def test_b2c_authority_mixed_scopes_allowed(self):
        """Test that B2C authority allows mixed scopes that would be rejected for regular apps."""
        app = PublicClientApplication(
            client_id=self.client_id,
            authority="https://mytenant.b2clogin.com/mytenant.onmicrosoft.com/B2C_1_signupsignin",
            http_client=MockB2CHttpClient()
        )
        
        # This combination would be rejected by regular apps but should work for B2C
        scopes = [self.client_id, 'openid', 'custom_scope']
        result = app._decorate_scope(scopes)
        result_set = set(result)
        
        # Should contain all input scopes plus auto-added profile
        expected = {self.client_id, 'openid', 'custom_scope', 'profile', 'offline_access'}
        self.assertEqual(result_set, expected)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
